title: Wrist and pelvic fractures to SNF; plan discussion, provider list, choice and quality data all documented in plain-language CM narrative

rationale.dp_discussed: 'Went over the plan with both of them ... They are on board' documents a discussion with the patient and her sister and their agreement.
rationale.pac_list: 'I gave them the county roster of Medicare-certified nursing homes that have rehab beds (14 facilities)' is the Medicare-participating provider list, phrased as a roster.
rationale.pac_choice: The CM told her 'the decision is hers alone', offered referrals anywhere she wanted, and her first choice (Harbor View) is the facility she went to.
rationale.pac_quality_data: 'We went through the CMS five-star scores and the staffing and inspection results for each facility' is quality data shared to support the choice.
